data.one_liner: Integrate Agora Chat instant messaging services into Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: The Agora Chat SDK enables developers to embed real-time messaging and instant messaging services into mobile apps. It supports peer-to-peer messaging, group chats, chat rooms, and various media message types like text, images, and files.
use_when: You need real-time instant messaging in your Flutter app.
You want to integrate Agora's global IM infrastructure.
You require support for peer-to-peer text, media, and command messages.
avoid_when: You are looking for a complete pre-built UI chat kit rather than just a headless SDK.
You do not require third-party backend services for messaging.
strengths: High reliability, ultra-low latency, and high concurrency
Supports multiple message types including text, images, video, audio, and files
Cross-platform support for iOS and Android
weaknesses: Requires manual event listener management and cleanup
Setup requires specific native configuration changes for Android and iOS
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minimum Android SDK version to 21, adding ProGuard rules, setting iOS minimum version to 12.0, and configuring Agora console tokens.
